messages:
elaine.green: Hey everyone — hi! I'm Elaine, just started today as a PM on Platform. Quick setup questions: who do I ping for a company Mac + MDM enrollment? Also need VPN + SSH access to staging. Appreciated! :wave:

sam.wells: Welcome Elaine! :tada: Ping @anais.hr for hardware. @devex-bot usually sends the MDM invite automatically. I just added you to #platform-standup and can grab lunch Wed if you want to meet the team.

maya.li: hi Elaine — for VPN we use Okta + Duo. Onboarding doc is here: https://redwood.docs/onboard/vpn. For SSH, easiest is to paste your public key into the onboarding form or DM me. Quick snippet if you need to generate one:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "elaine.green@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
If you'd rather I add it, DM the key and I'll attach it to your account.

tilly.eng: Adding you to the infra-access group now. Staging requires the `staging-access` role — I'll attach that and notify infra so they can accept. If you run into permission denied, react here with :raised_hand: and I'll hop on.

kiran.patel: Welcome! I scheduled a 30m intro for 1pm PT tomorrow to go over priorities + handoff context. Bring any questions about model-serving or deploy flow.

anais.hr: Welcome Elaine — I'm Anais from People Ops. I've opened a provisioning ticket and sent the benefits/equipment form: https://redwood.hr/forms/onboard. Please fill mailing address and preferred laptop config. I'll DM about sticker preferences and badge pickup. :sparkles: 

devex-bot: devex-bot: Onboarding checklist created (ONB-2024). MDM enrollment email will be sent within the hour. If you don't get it, reply here and we'll escalate.

elaine.green: Thanks all — I'll DM @maya.li my SSH key now. Lunch Wed sounds great — what time works for folks?

sam.wells: Noon works for me, @elaine.green — ramen place near office. 🍜

kiran.patel: I'll join at noon. Welcome aboard again!
